{{Quote|Master Kenobi has taken the Jixuan desert, so the southern hemisphere is ours.|[[Mace Windu]]|audio=JixuanDesert-LoR.flac|<ref name="Liberty" />}}
The '''Jixuan desert''' was located in the southern hemisphere of the [[planet]] [[Ryloth]].<ref name="Liberty" /> In [[21 BBY]],<ref name="Timelines">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]''</ref> during the [[Galactic Republic]]'s efforts to [[Battle of Ryloth|liberate]] the planet from the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]]' control in the [[Clone Wars]], the Republic forces of [[Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] had managed to gain control of the Jixuan [[desert]]<ref name="Liberty" /> following their engagements with the [[Separatist Droid Army]] in the settlement of [[Nabat]]<ref name="Innocents">{{TCW|Innocents of Ryloth}}</ref> and other villages. With Kenobi's capture of the desert, the Republic was able to claim control over the planet's southern hemisphere.<ref name="Liberty" /> At some point after [[34 ABY]], an illustration of the desert was on a [[map]] of Ryloth thought to have been drawn by the [[artist]] [[Gammit Chond]] based purely on travelers' tales. The map was later restored and published by the [[Graf Archive]].<ref name="Atlas">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Jixuan desert was introduced via [[Hologram|holographic projection]] in "[[Liberty on Ryloth]],"<ref name="Liberty" /> the twenty-first episode of the [[The Clone Wars: Season One|first season]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' animated television series, which aired on [[March 13]], [[2009]].<ref name="Liberty Ep Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode021.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Liberty on Ryloth}}</ref>
